sheets.title: Offline reset beside a sealed vault — 390 × 844, touch
sheets.caption: Beside a sealed vault, taken offline, then Erase. The vault, sign-in and settings go; the offline app is kept so the next load has something to load. Before, the tab left for a first visit as if everything had gone. After, the panel stays and names what remains, with erase again and start as a first visit as the two keys.
